ticket.subject: Cannot reach our EU workspaces
ticket.body_text:
Hey team,

I'm the engineering manager at Brambleway Studio. Your EU region seems to be down: every request to our EU workspaces times out for our whole team in Madrid and Berlin.

Our US workspace still works.

We have a hard deadline tomorrow morning, so please treat this as urgent. Is there an incident open?

Cheers,
Freya

label_notes: clean outage (outage-eu-region): a whole region is unreachable, so outage P1; urgency high: ongoing impact or a deadline within 24 h.
